subject: mathematics

location.unitTitle: Quantitative Reasoning, Units, and Rational Exponents

instructions: Work independently. Show the mathematical steps or representation that support each response.
Check each result before submitting. A response without the requested work may require adult review.

learnerTasks.prompt: A rectangular plot measures 59.7 m by 7.3 m, each measured to the nearest tenth of a metre. Report the area to 1 decimal place.
You are building a model of the rate at which a reservoir is draining. Which unit should the modelled quantity be reported in?
A bottling line operates at 29 grams per second. Express this rate in kilograms per hour.
Rewrite the square root expression √(x^5) using a rational exponent, in lowest terms.
Classify the sum of the rational number 3 and the irrational number √5 as rational or irrational, and be ready to justify it.
Option A delivers 66 units of output over 6 hours. Option B delivers 48 units over 8 hours. Which has the greater output per hour?
choices: There is not enough information without knowing the total hours available.

learnerTasks.prompt: A rectangular plot measures 62.8 m by 7.1 m, each measured to the nearest tenth of a metre. Report the area to 2 decimal places.
You are building a model of the cost effectiveness of two phone plans. Which unit should the modelled quantity be reported in?
An irrigation pump operates at 50 liters per minute. Express this rate in liters per hour.
Rewrite the index-5 radical expression 5√(x^3) using a rational exponent, in lowest terms.
